Vendored xattr 0.2.3 from crates.io (checksum 6d1526bbe5aaeb5eb06885f4d987bcdfa5e23187055de9b83fe00156a821fabc). GPUI 0.2.2 reaches this release through zed-async-tar. The errno change uses ENODATA on Linux and Android because libc 0.2.190 removed the deprecated ENOATTR alias. Other platform values are unchanged. The deprecated macOS uint32_t spelling is replaced with the identical u32 type. Upstream: https://github.com/Stebalien/xattr. Retain both license files.
